projects.title: The Unique Home Services
projects.desc: Full-stack React website for a US-based home services company offering electrical, HVAC, cleaning, and repair services. Built with React, responsive design, service pages, contact forms, and WhatsApp/call CTAs for instant lead capture.

projects.title: JBS We Carry
projects.desc: Full-stack B2B e-commerce platform for a bag manufacturing & corporate-gifting brand. Built with React 18 + Vite frontend and a Node/Express + Drizzle (Neon Postgres) backend. Features real 3D bag viewers and AR 'view in your room' (Three.js + model-viewer/WebXR), 360° product rotation, JWT auth with Google Sign-In & OTP, Razorpay + COD checkout, wishlist/cart, bulk-order quotations (PDF generation), reviews, dark/light theme, and a full admin dashboard (products, orders, customers, coupons, reviews, bulk upload).

projects.title: SF Admin Tool Kit
projects.desc: SF Admin Toolkit is a Chrome extension designed for Salesforce admins and developers to simplify daily operations. It provides quick access to Session IDs, profile-based access management, object and field permissions, user management, metadata handling, Apex test execution, Flows, Workflow Rules, Approval Processes, Static Resources, and Salesforce setup navigation. The extension helps streamline Salesforce administration, reduce manual navigation time, and improve overall productivity with secure direct API usage and zero data storage.
